audit.summary: The general cell-boundary SDP construction uses a false common-face distance formula whose derivative is also wrong in a finite CAT(0) four-square example. Core Hadamard recognition and maximal-cell interior mechanisms survived bounded checks. Auxiliary primal-attainment proof confuses selected-bicombing and all-geodesics convexity.

proposition.claim:
Kind: paraphrase

Locator: Section 11, PDF p35 common-face formula; dependency pp36–37; cell definitions p27

Text: For incident cells C,Q_a and F_a=C intersect Q_a, every geodesic from x_a to y in C crosses F_a, yielding a minimum of two within-cell lengths used to construct the directional derivative SDP.

Finite complete CAT(0) cubical complex X=[-1,1]^2 with four unit squares. xbar=0, Q_a=[-1,0]^2, C=[0,1]^2 both maximal. a=x_a=(-1/2,-1/2), y=(1/2,1/4); initial segment lies wholly in Q_a.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: PDF p11 convex-set definition; Definitions4.1–4.2 and Theorem4.3 pp12–13; Assumption3.1 p8

Text: The proof declares every F_k convex after showing preservation only along the chosen conical bicombing and then invokes reflexivity.

X=(R^2,l_infinity), A={0}, p=1, Y=R, G=identity, c=1,b=0. Strict primal and dual feasible via xhat0,yhat1,what1. Proper finite-dimensional space and linear conical bicombing; nu0 and F_k=[-r,r]^2,r=1/k.
